Who is calling, personal accounts and organisations, members, invites and usage.

## Who is calling

`GET /v1/whoami` (SDK method `getCaller`)

The person or key calling, the accounts they may act in (their personal account first), the deployment's mode, and whether it keeps protected variables and secret files (`protectedValues`), so a client can check before it makes an environment that needs them. Any key may call it.

**Answers**

- `200`: [Caller](/api/reference/types/#caller) (`application/json`). The caller.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Delete your account

`DELETE /v1/whoami` (SDK method `deleteCaller`)

Deletes the calling person and their personal account: its hosts are removed, every API key that acts for them is revoked, they leave every organisation, and their sign-ins end. Their private sandboxes in an organisation stay, stopped, as when they leave it. `conflict` while their personal account has sandboxes or saved snapshots, or while they are an organisation's last owner. People only, and not a deployment super-admin.

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Deleted.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List accounts

`GET /v1/accounts` (SDK method `listAccounts`)

The caller's personal account and every organisation they belong to; for a key, its own account. A key needs `account:read`.

**Answers**

- `200`: [AccountList](/api/reference/types/#accountlist) (`application/json`). The accounts.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create an organisation

`POST /v1/accounts` (SDK method `createOrganisation`)

Makes an organisation account with the caller as its owner. People only: a key is refused.

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreateOrganisationBody](/api/reference/types/#createorganisationbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Account](/api/reference/types/#account) (`application/json`). The organisation.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict, `422` refused, `429` exhausted. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Join an organisation

`POST /v1/accounts/join` (SDK method `joinOrganisation`)

Joins the organisation an invite's code is for, with the invite's role. People only. An expired or used code is `expired`.

**Body**: [JoinOrganisationBody](/api/reference/types/#joinorganisationbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Account](/api/reference/types/#account) (`application/json`). The organisation joined.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `410` expired. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change an account

`PATCH /v1/accounts/{accountId}` (SDK method `updateAccount`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The account's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateAccountBody](/api/reference/types/#updateaccountbody)

- `200`: [Account](/api/reference/types/#account) (`application/json`). The account.

## Delete an organisation

`DELETE /v1/accounts/{accountId}` (SDK method `deleteOrganisation`)

Deletes an organisation with no sandboxes or saved snapshots left (`conflict` otherwise); needs its owner. A personal account can't be deleted here. People only.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The account's ID. |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Deleted.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get an account's usage

`GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/usage` (SDK method `getAccountUsage`)

Running time and cost since `since`, and the account's limits. A key needs `account:read`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The account's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | integer | no | From this time; default 24 hours ago. `series` then holds only the points after it, so a client polls with the last point's `at`. |
| `intervalSeconds` | integer | no | Default 300. (minimum 60, maximum 86400) |

**Answers**

- `200`: [AccountUsage](/api/reference/types/#accountusage) (`application/json`). The usage.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change a member's role

`PATCH /v1/accounts/{accountId}/members/{userId}` (SDK method `updateMember`)

Needs admin; only an owner makes or unmakes an owner, and the last owner stays. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The organisation's account ID. |
| `userId` | string | yes | The member's user ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateMemberBody](/api/reference/types/#updatememberbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Member](/api/reference/types/#member) (`application/json`). The member.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Remove a member

`DELETE /v1/accounts/{accountId}/members/{userId}` (SDK method `removeMember`)

Removes a member, or lets a member leave. Their private sandboxes in the organisation stay, stopped, for an admin to delete or share. The last owner can't leave. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The organisation's account ID. |
| `userId` | string | yes | The member's user ID. |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Removed.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Invite someone to an organisation

`POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/invites` (SDK method `createInvite`)

Makes a join code, shown once, for one person or for anyone holding it; needs admin. A key needs `account:admin`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The account's ID. |

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreateInviteBody](/api/reference/types/#createinvitebody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Invite](/api/reference/types/#invite) (`application/json`). The invite, with its code.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `422` refused. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get an organisation's E2E chain

`GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/e2e/chain` (SDK method `getE2EChain`)

Its signed entries, oldest first: empty until an admin starts it with `kantel e2e init`. A key needs `account:read`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The account's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [E2EChain](/api/reference/types/#e2echain) (`application/json`). The chain.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Add entries to an organisation's E2E chain

`POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/e2e/chain` (SDK method `appendE2EChain`)

Entries a member's device signed, from the chain's length. The whole chain must still verify; `conflict` when another entry got there first. Only an admin starts a chain. A key needs `account:read`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accountId` | string | yes | The account's ID. |

**Body**: [E2EChainAppend](/api/reference/types/#e2echainappend)

**Answers**

- `200`: [E2EChain](/api/reference/types/#e2echain) (`application/json`). The chain now.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
